# Codea download packages

| File | Load on iPad |
|------|----------------|
| **`MetallicLabyrinth.codea.zip`** | **Download this** → unzip → copy `MetallicLabyrinth.codea` into **Files → On My iPad → Codea** → Play |
| `MetallicLabyrinth.lua` | Same game as one buffer (paste into a new Codea project if you cannot copy the folder) |
| **`AnatomyBallistics-1.1.0-complete.codea.zip`** | **Download this** → unzip → copy `AnatomyBallistics.codea` into **Files → On My iPad → Codea** → open Codea |
| `AnatomyBallistics.codea.zip` | Same project (unversioned alias) |
| `AnatomyBallistics-1.1.0.codea.zip` | Same project (version alias) |

**Metallic Labyrinth** — tilt-to-roll maze. Source: `../MetallicLabyrinth/`

**.22 LR anatomy sandbox** — soft-body tissue, organ vitals, staged ranges 40→15 ft, then drywall+wood wall. Source: `../AnatomyBallistics/`
